item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Earth, Sun and the apparent motion of the sky
item.stem: Meera looks out of the window of her home in Delhi. It is morning and the Sun is shining. Her pen-friend Arjun, who lives on the opposite side of the Earth, says it is night where he is. Why do day and night occur at a place on Earth?

options.A: The Sun moves around the Earth once every day.
options.B: The Earth rotates on its axis, moving each place into and out of the side facing the Sun.
options.C: The Earth moves around the Sun once every year.
options.D: The Moon blocks the Sun's light every night.
